key.betterxray.quick_add_block: Add Looked-at Block to X-Ray Preset
screen.betterxray.title: Better X-Ray
screen.betterxray.apply: Changes apply when this screen closes.
tooltip.betterxray.opacity_shader: The active shader pack ignores the terrain opacity, so faint terrain is hidden as at 0 %%. Ores, caves, highlights and ESP keep working; the value applies again without that pack.
tooltip.betterxray.shader_opacity: Experimental: lets shader packs that ignore the terrain opacity (e.g. Complementary, BSL) show faint terrain by patching their terrain shaders. Reloads the shader pack. Turn it off if the pack fails to load or looks wrong.
option.betterxray.esp_color_hint: Click to choose a palette color, or use RGB sliders for a custom color.
screen.betterxray.search_mob: Search mob, registry ID or group…
tooltip.betterxray.esp_group_toggle: Turn ESP on or off for the whole group. Mobs with their own setting keep it.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_group_open: Click to set the group's style and color. Click the arrow (or press Left/Right) to collapse.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_mob_toggle: Turn ESP on or off for this mob only.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_group_enabled: Default for every mob in this group. Mobs with their own setting keep it.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_mob_inherit: Click to cycle: follow the group, own setting, back to the group.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_group_link: Edit the defaults shared by all mobs of this group.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_reset_overrides: Removes the individual ESP settings of all mobs in this group, so they follow the group again.
screen.betterxray.search_mob_item: Search mob, item, registry ID or group…
tooltip.betterxray.esp_pick_items: Opens the list of all items with its own search and a filter for enabled items.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_item_entity_toggl: Turn ESP on or off for all dropped items. Items with their own setting keep it; click the arrow to pick single items.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_item_toggle: Turn ESP on or off for this item only.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_item_inherit: Click to cycle: follow the Item settings, own setting, back to the Item settings.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_item_link: Edit the defaults shared by all dropped items.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_reset_item_overri: Removes the individual ESP settings of all items, so they follow the Item settings again.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_master: Master switch for all ESP (default hotkey J). Group and mob settings are kept.
tooltip.betterxray.cave_find: Shows caves through the terrain: block faces next to underground air (no sky light) stay solid and lit, everything else follows the terrain opacity. Works on its own; preset blocks are only shown when X-Ray is on as well (default hotkey U).
tooltip.betterxray.hide_mobs: Which mobs are not drawn while X-Ray or Cave-Find is on. Behind Walls hides only mobs behind blocks (e.g. underground) and keeps those you can see directly; All hides every mob. Players, objects and mobs with ESP stay visible.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_tracers_master: Master switch for the ESP tracers (default hotkey K). Which groups and mobs get a tracer is kept.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_group_tracer: Draws a line from the screen center to every mob of this group that has ESP, also through walls and behind you. Mobs with their own setting keep it.
tooltip.betterxray.range: Only highlighted blocks within this distance of the camera are outlined and get tracers.
tooltip.betterxray.group_veins: Adjacent blocks of the same kind (also touching diagonally) form a vein: one box and one tracer. Deepslate ores join their stone variant. Very common blocks result in very large boxes.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_range: Only mobs and players within this distance of the camera get ESP. Applies to all groups.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_player_name: Shows the player's name above the head, also through walls. Applies to all players.
tooltip.betterxray.esp_player_health: Shows the player's health above the head as numbers, a bar or both. Applies to all players.
tooltip.betterxray.update_check: Checks once per game start, in the first singleplayer world, whether a new version is available on CurseForge. The hint only appears in your own chat.
tooltip.betterxray.highlight_use_global: Removes this block's own color; it follows the global color again.
tooltip.betterxray.highlight_reset_color: Every block uses the global color again. To give one block its own color, click the color square at the end of its row (or press Right).
label.betterxray.structures_singleplayer: Singleplayer only: structure data exists only on the server
message.betterxray.unavailable: X-Ray unavailable with this renderer / shader pack
message.betterxray.nvidium: [Better X-Ray: Nvidium is not supported and can cause problems such as missing ores or crashes. Remove Nvidium if X-Ray does not work correctly.]
command.betterxray.empty_tag: Tag %s lists no blocks in this world (unknown tag or mod missing?)
command.betterxray.tags_no_world: Block tags are only known inside a world
command.betterxray.status.xray: X-Ray: %s · %s (%s entries, %s blocks) · Opacity %s%% · Water %s · Lava %s
command.betterxray.help.entries: edit the active preset; several IDs/tags separated by spaces
command.betterxray.help.list: show or empty the active preset
command.betterxray.help.preset: show, switch, rename or reset presets
command.betterxray.help.hide_mobs: hide no mobs, mobs behind walls or all mobs; without an argument it cycles
command.betterxray.help.highlight: Highlight and its block list, tracers and range
command.betterxray.help.esp: Mob/player ESP master switch, tracers and range
command.betterxray.help.tags: find block tags and their blocks
